edits.before: - Zoe Sleepy Trouble Bubble: matchup-defining — Sleep into empowered Q is the entire kill pattern — body-block it with minions or terrain. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget R Petrifying Gaze for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Sleepy Trouble Bubble is 18s at rank 1 and 14s at rank 5 — body-block the bubble, then step up inside that window. - Paddle Star is 8.5s at rank 1 against your 3.5s Q. - Portal Jump is 11s at rank 1 and 5s at rank 3, so it is never the gap.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by patience: Zoe has one combo and an 18-second bubble, so live through it and the next 18 seconds are all yours.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, zone Zoe off the wave with fang threat, and call your jungler — your W makes every gank a guaranteed kill.

notes: Eleven misgendered fields fixed — Zoe is she/her and the template had been written for a male enemy. The page's recurring 'fifteen seconds he has nothing' was also wrong on the number: Sleepy Trouble Bubble is 18/17/16/15/14, so fifteen is only true at rank 4; every instance now says 18. LEVEL CHART: the full layer read Skill on all seven rows while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Zoe, Zoe, Skill, Cassiopeia x4; the full sides were moved to match and phases[0].why / phases[1].why rewritten in the same proposal so no row argues with its sentence. No win[N] edits appear because the content layer already holds every target value on disk. NOT WRITTEN: the kit tags Sleepy Trouble Bubble with a trueDamage flag and missingInteractions asks for a 'resistances-invalidated' line, but Riot's own E text says the sleep REDUCES magic resist and doubles the waking hit — it never mentions true damage. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and left true damage off the page. Both packet.suspectNames entries are false positives.
